texts.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]的地表被使用核武的战争所毁灭，整个星球就像是一座坟墓。如今满地白骨的地方曾经是人群聚集的中心，在这荒凉、被灰烬所覆盖的地表之上，唯一能听到的只有那呼啸的风声。

一种当地的昆虫似乎在充满辐射的环境中兴起。变异后的种群在体型上迅速增大，一些群落则表现出了基本的智慧特征。
texts.en:
The surface of [From.From.From.GetName] has been ravaged by nuclear war, and the planet is little more than a tomb. Withered concrete skeletons jut out of the ground where major population centers once stood, and the howling wind is all that can be heard on the desolate, ash-covered surface.

A local species of insect seems to be thriving in the irradiated environment. Mutated specimens have increased dramatically in size, and some communities are displaying signs of rudimentary intelligence.

# 核废墟 / Nuclear Wasteland

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration

## 如何开始 How it starts

无随机生成：太阳系初始化器把该异常直接放在地球（pc_nuked，标记 nuked_earth，sol_initializers.txt:3448）。

No random spawn: the Sol system initializer places the anomaly directly on Earth (pc_nuked, flag nuked_earth, sol_initializers.txt:3448).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 galactic_features.104“核毁灭”：在该星球创建前智能蟑螂物种（NAME_Cockroach，3个人口群，非智慧）并设置国家标志 found_presapients；唯一选项无其他效果。

Single result galactic_features.104 "Nuclear Devastation": creates a pre-sapient cockroach species (NAME_Cockroach, three non-sapient pop groups) on the planet and sets country flag found_presapients; the single option has no further effect.
